name: Security audit (LLM, operator-run)
cadence: on demand (via an operator running bin/security-audit.sh <project>; no cron line)

knobs.note: no static default — the script computes it ($REPO/catalog/security-audit.conf). Read by bin/security-audit.sh as ${SA_CONF:-$REPO/catalog/security-audit.conf}. A test seam and a path: NOT settable from the control plane.
Seconds between cap polls. Read by bin/security-audit.sh as ${SA_POLL_S:-<conf poll_s, else 30>}. A test seam: the operator value is poll_s in catalog/security-audit.conf.
Seconds per cap minute. Read by bin/security-audit.sh as ${SA_MINUTE_S:-60}. A test seam only: tests shrink a cap minute to seconds.

Seconds between TERM and KILL when a cap stops the session. Read by bin/security-audit.sh as ${SA_KILL_GRACE_S:-<conf kill_grace_s, else 30>}. A test seam: the operator value is kill_grace_s in the conf.

The clone url of the target. Read by bin/security-audit.sh as ${SA_REPO_URL:-}; empty falls through to the live checkout's origin, then fleet.conf. A test seam and a url: NOT settable from the control plane.
Where the live checkouts are. Read by bin/security-audit.sh as ${SA_REPOS_DIR:-/root/repos}. A path: NOT settable from the control plane.

no static default — the script computes it ($SELF/agent-call.sh). Read by bin/security-audit.sh as ${SA_AGENT_CALL:-$SELF/agent-call.sh}. The command the audit runs, a test seam: NOT settable from the control plane.

0 makes the audit call no model at all. bin/agent-call.sh (AGENT_CALL_LANE=security-audit) refuses through bin/lib/llm-gate.sh BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row; bin/security-audit.sh then exits 5 with 'agent-call refused (nothing billed)'.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs the stage.audit call may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.

Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend. It is a day ceiling over all runs; the per-run caps stay security_audit.cap_usd and security_audit.cap_minutes (settings rows, else catalog/security-audit.conf).
